title: Park Maui paid and resident parking rules
summary: Bill 68 updates Park Maui zones, giving Hawaiʻi residents two free hours at the Wailuku Garage and creating paid parking at three Lahaina lots. It passed first reading 9–0 on July 7 and final reading on July 24. A question on the app's convenience fee was sent to county lawyers.

timeline.text: Bill 68, updating West Maui parking rules, passed first reading 9–0.
